source: Official automatic 3DBAG/Roofer-lineage teacher, not independent measured GT

scope.canonical_manifest_access: opaque SHA256 only; source city snapshots decoded
scope.authoritative_subsets_access: source ID lists only; final ID lists unused

definitions.plane_count: Frozen parser approximate coplanar teacher support groups across complete BAG parent; not human roof facets, connected polygons, roof-style labels or a slope test.
definitions.area_m2: Sum of XY-projected admitted roof triangle areas, not 3D sloped surface area.
definitions.source_ahn_year: Per-building source AHN metadata year, not a uniform imagery date, guaranteed survey instant or roof-change verification.
definitions.quantiles: Each building weighted once; NumPy linear quantiles. No area weighting.
definitions.units: RD New XY metres, NAP Z metres (EPSG:7415).

conclusions_zh: 每个训练规模都由同10座城市等额构成：3500/10000/20000分别为每城350/1000/2000栋；城市数量组成没有失衡。
3500→20000新增16500栋中，近似共面组2–4的有11467栋、5+的有1851栋；多组屋面合计13318栋（80.7%），因此增加并非全部来自单组屋面。
单组屋面占比由3500规模的19.00%变为20000规模的19.23%，变化+0.23个百分点。
近似共面组数不是坡度、人工屋面片或屋脊样式标签；单组既可能水平也可能倾斜，仅凭本报告不能判断平屋顶占比。
城市等额不代表屋面形状、面积、年代或空间分布相同；固定API首个合格样本与v2网格补采不是人口随机抽样。
建筑高度未存入manifest，不能在不打开网格的约束下报告高度分位数；地面绝对高程不能替代建筑高度。
